title: Leslie Kean publishes the Grusch article in The Debrief after the New York Times passes

tellings.quote:
Leslie Kane published the initial
article that prompted the whole thing
but she had to do it in the debrief
because Julian Barnes

plain: The 2023 article that first made public the claims of David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who says the US has secretly recovered craft that are not of human making, was written by the journalist Leslie Kean and ran in The Debrief, a small online news site, rather than in the New York Times. Michels tells it as he heard it: Kean 'had to do it in The Debrief' because of Julian Barnes, a New York Times reporter, the story being that the Times passed on it. The point is that the article that set off the whole affair was turned down by a major paper.
